---
title: "2022 Florida Gubernatorial Election Results"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(tigris)
library(sf)
library(scales)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)

# Cache shapefiles so downloads are fast
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
# Load election results by county
election_data <- read_csv("data/20221108__fl__general__county.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Filter for the Governor race and compute vote totals and margins per county
gov_results <- election_data |> 
  filter(office == "Governor", !candidate %in% c("OverVotes", "UnderVotes")) |> 
  mutate(county = if_else(county == "Desoto", "DeSoto", county)) |> 
  group_by(county) |> 
  summarize(
    total_votes = sum(votes),
    dem_votes = sum(votes[party == "DEM"]),
    rep_votes = sum(votes[party == "REP"]),
    dem_pct = dem_votes / total_votes * 100,
    rep_pct = rep_votes / total_votes * 100,
    rep_margin = rep_pct - dem_pct,
    winner = if_else(rep_votes > dem_votes, "Ron DeSantis (R)", "Charlie Crist (D)")
  )

# Get Florida county boundaries and transform to WGS84 for Leaflet
fl_counties <- counties(state = "FL", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |> 
  st_transform(4326)

# Join spatial geometries with election data
fl_map_data <- fl_counties |> 
  left_join(gov_results, by = c("NAME" = "county"))
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-interactive-map
# Define symmetric color palette for Republican margin
max_margin <- max(abs(fl_map_data$rep_margin), na.rm = TRUE)
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c("#2166ac", "#f7f7f7", "#b2182b"),
  domain = c(-max_margin, max_margin)
)

# Create hover labels with county details
labels <- sprintf(
  "<strong>%s County</strong><br/>
   Winner: %s<br/>
   DeSantis (R): %s (%.1f%%)<br/>
   Crist (D): %s (%.1f%%)<br/>
   Margin: %+.1f%%",
  fl_map_data$NAME,
  fl_map_data$winner,
  comma(fl_map_data$rep_votes), fl_map_data$rep_pct,
  comma(fl_map_data$dem_votes), fl_map_data$dem_pct,
  fl_map_data$rep_margin
) |> 
  map(HTML)

# Build interactive leaflet map
leaflet(fl_map_data) |> 
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |> 
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(rep_margin),
    weight = 1,
    opacity = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2,
      color = "#444",
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    label = labels
  ) |> 
  addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = ~rep_margin,
    opacity = 0.7,
    title = "DeSantis Margin (%)",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```
